aptenodytes-forsteri.title: Emperor penguin — retained exterior, revised underwater neck posture
aptenodytes-forsteri.author: Marcel Porsiel; adaptations and motion studies by PhenoVoxel Archive
aptenodytes-forsteri.surfaceType: Marcel Porsiel textured exterior with retained images and UVs, emperor adaptations and a bound skeleton
aptenodytes-forsteri.changes: A continuous bend replaces the stretched underwater neck transition. The standing exterior, skin weights, original texture images, UVs, joints and animation curves are retained. Only the underwater neck shape and adjacent surface normals change. Body/shoulder contour and foot-morph limitations remain; this is an illustrative external posture, not validated cervical anatomy or physiology.
aptenodytes-forsteri.biology: Species-informed exterior interpretation. Active stroke frequency is referenced to one emperor field dataset; amplitudes, body shape, step length and forces are not measured or simulated.

viewerRig.type: Seven-joint bound skeleton and continuous swimming-posture morph
viewerRig.scope: Qualitative locomotion; 1.47 Hz active cycle referenced to Sato et al. 2010 table 2. No calibrated speed, thrust, energetics, thermoregulation or complete physiology.
